description: List JustIdea Agency services with the published starting ("from") prices and links. Returns the price list (12 service categories, each with its packages) and every service page with its short description. All prices are net (VAT excluded) and exactly as published on justidea.agency. Use get_page for the full scope of a service and search_site for city pages, case studies and articles.

language.description: Site language: "pl" (prices in PLN) or "en" (prices in EUR for clients outside Poland).

name: list_services
title: Services and prices
